shots.title: Hall master — geometry and style anchor
shots.prompt: Generate one empty Hall of Scripts master plate in neutral morning light, wide eye-level three-quarter view. Show a modest working hall with warm plaster, cedar furniture, stone or packed-earth flooring and restrained bronze fittings. Place one functional entrance and the intake zone screen-left; keep a broad open central acting floor; place the cedar display stand slightly deeper, catalogue shelves along the right/back wall, a worktable nearby and a quiet scribal bench at the side. High daylight enters from screen-left. Use blank stored clay, leather, bark and silk materials sparingly on shelves to establish the hall's work, without readable marks. The furniture has plausible human scale; the stand and worktable do not form a continuous foreground barrier. Keep the bottom caption area quiet. Match the attached character art without painting any characters. This image proposes the room layout; return only this master first so I can select it before related views.
shots.actual_model: Gemini web, reported by owner; exact model unknown
